selection.matching: Case-insensitive keyword match against captured preset id, name, description, group and tags; each distinct matching keyword adds affinityBonus.
selection.sampling: Seeded weighted ordering without replacement within each complete family bag; no keyword match leaves the positive base weight intact.
selection.neural: All captured models remain eligible. Choose each model's semantic context from its actual captured training anchors.
selection.persistence: Store story id, policy version, pinned catalog hash, selected preset ids, motif parameters and completed job receipts with the game instance. Keep this RNG separate from combat.

constraints.foundation: Preserve the complete solid-stone bottom tile.
constraints.playArea: Retain connected central tank space and the 25-percent survivor frame; use real supported dry starting positions.
constraints.decoration: Run all selected decoration passes. Gentle imperfect clearance targets foreground only and preserves other layers and bodies.
constraints.contraptions: Place bounded supported assemblies in empty space with native vector/line/body jobs. Gravity, collision, carving and material reactions determine their outcome; no scripted collision, hinges, pressure or teleport substitutes.
constraints.emitterGate: PARTICLE_SPAWNER and PARTICLE_DRAIN are real catalog elements. Device motifs require verified public configuration, bounded output/placement, lifecycle and save behavior before activation. Their names alone do not define their output settings.
constraints.simulation: Remote terrain construction does not certify off-camera heat, air, fields or chemical reactions. Accept thermal/device motifs inside an actually simulated region.

themes.name: Last Pumping Station
themes.description: A post-apocalyptic waterworks survives above flooded streets: broken rooftops, rusted aqueducts and improvised timber dams surround one dry service road.

motifs.name: Rooftop reservoir
motifs.trigger: Break the timber or glass plug under a supported water pocket.
sequence: WATER drops into a sloping stone channel.
The spill passes through a breakable lower barrier into a side basin away from tank starts.

motifs.name: Aqueduct domino
motifs.trigger: Destroy a narrow wooden prop beneath a concrete deck.
sequence: The unsupported deck falls onto the next supported plank.
A stone weight is released onto an adjoining ramp and rolls into visible rubble.

motifs.name: The last running pump
motifs.trigger: Open an obstructed spillway between the inlet and drain basin.
sequence: A configured PARTICLE_SPAWNER supplies bounded WATER to an elevated basin.
WATER follows the opened route to a configured PARTICLE_DRAIN.

themes.name: Nine Floors Below
themes.description: Terraced hell caverns alternate black rock, ember pockets and narrow bridges. Separate water chambers offer small interruptions in a descending volcanic landscape.

motifs.name: Stairway of bad decisions
motifs.trigger: Break a timber support at the top of offset basalt ledges.
sequence: The first stone weight falls onto a sloped wooden deck.
The deck tips or falls, carrying the weight toward the next lower ledge.

motifs.name: A little mercy
motifs.trigger: Break a glass barrier between a small water chamber and a lower lava pocket.
sequence: WATER runs down the rock chute into LAVA.
Native thermal reactions alter the pocket; verify the actual resulting material instead of assuming steam thrust or a scripted blast.

motifs.name: Ember gate
motifs.trigger: Expose a wood-supported stone gate to a separate ember pocket.
sequence: Native fire consumes the accessible wooden support.
The stone gate drops into the cavity below and changes the firing route.

themes.name: Drowned Cathedral
themes.description: A flooded cave swallowed a cathedral. Masonry ribs, coral pools and surviving timber walkways frame a dry central nave above spillways and crypt drains.

motifs.name: The last bell
motifs.trigger: Shoot out the wooden cradle under a heavy round metal body.
sequence: The bell-shaped weight falls onto a sloping stone ramp.
Its contact knocks loose a smaller plank blocking a lower passage.

motifs.name: Crypt spillways
motifs.trigger: Break one of two small timber plugs at different reservoir heights.
sequence: WATER spills into the selected side channel.
A verified drain at the lowest crypt bounds the active water accumulation.

motifs.name: Broken rib
motifs.trigger: Remove a small wooden support beneath a segmented masonry crossing.
sequence: Separate MARBLE blocks fall under native gravity.
The blocks strike lower debris and make an irregular obstruction or new stepping surface.

themes.name: Black Gold Graveyard
themes.description: A dead refinery leaks into narrow trenches. Fuel, small ignition sites and fragile barriers are visibly separated so the player can choose when a chain begins.

motifs.name: Leaking storage cell
motifs.trigger: Fracture the thin glass outlet of a contained oil pocket.
sequence: CRUDE_OIL runs down a shallow concrete trench.
If it reaches the separate active ignition site, native fire may consume fuel and nearby wooden props.

motifs.name: Refinery dominoes
motifs.trigger: Remove the brace beneath the first slightly tilted metal slab.
sequence: Several separate slabs topple through contact.
The final slab falls onto a wooden cover over the lower channel.

motifs.name: Fuel feed and sump
motifs.trigger: Open the sluice in a bounded fuel-feed basin.
sequence: A configured PARTICLE_SPAWNER emits CRUDE_OIL into the authored channel.
A downstream PARTICLE_DRAIN and verified rate/lifetime limit prevent an unbounded map-wide spill.

themes.name: City That Fell Sideways
themes.description: A shattered city lies at improbable angles: concrete shells lean on timber repairs, rooftop rubble becomes a downhill hazard, and the surviving road crosses the wreckage.

motifs.name: One more bad repair
motifs.trigger: Destroy the timber prop keeping a tilted concrete slab from falling.
sequence: The slab drops onto a shorter plank resting on rubble.
The plank pushes or releases a nearby round stone weight through native contact.

motifs.name: Rooftop hopper
motifs.trigger: Break the wooden floor of a small supported rubble bin.
sequence: GRAVEL and SAND fall onto an angled concrete shelf.
The material pours into a shallow street cavity, changing traversable ground.

motifs.name: Street of falling walls
motifs.trigger: Remove the small brace holding the first concrete wall segment.
sequence: Separate wall bodies topple into each other.
The last wall lands across a small gap or collapses into it according to the native contact result.

themes.name: Furnace Garden
themes.description: Living bramble and vines reclaim a foundry. Small hot pockets, cooling ponds and precarious iron castings coexist with broad areas of green growth.

motifs.name: The forgotten casting
motifs.trigger: Expose an old wooden stand to a small ember bed.
sequence: Native combustion weakens or removes the stand.
The iron casting falls onto lower stone and wooden pieces.

motifs.name: Emergency cooling
motifs.trigger: Break a glass plug above a small enclosed hot pocket.
sequence: WATER runs down a short rock chute.
The water and hot material react natively; inspect the actual cooling and material output.

motifs.name: Weight through the weeds
motifs.trigger: Remove a stone weight's timber chock on a raised plank.
sequence: The weight rolls down the native rigid ramp.
It strikes a second supported plank amid independently growing bramble; plants remain real organisms, not scripted switches.

themes.name: Glacier Boiler Room
themes.description: Ice sealed an industrial plant around stubborn hot chambers. Snow shelves and blue frozen walls contrast with rusted machinery and carefully contained sources of heat.

motifs.name: Thawing chock
motifs.trigger: Expose the ice stop holding a metal weight to an adjacent hot chamber.
sequence: Native heat changes the ice; verify that enough support actually disappears.
The freed weight rolls down a steel ramp into loose snow.

motifs.name: Snow hopper
motifs.trigger: Break a timber plug beneath a deep snow pocket.
sequence: SNOW falls down a sloped stone chute.
The snow collects in a lower basin and changes its floor height; thermal changes remain native.

motifs.name: Meltwater sluice
motifs.trigger: Open the lower timber gate below an ice chamber.
sequence: Existing WATER and any natively melted ice spill through the gate.
A configured PARTICLE_DRAIN accepts the flow in a low side basin.

themes.name: Hanging Quarry
themes.description: Shelves cut into a quarry carry heavy blocks on makeshift trestles. Angled planks and gravel chutes make falling supports and rolling weights easy to read before firing.

motifs.name: Quarry run
motifs.trigger: Break the timber chock beneath a round granite body.
sequence: The weight rolls over two supported sloping planks.
It hits a smaller upright stone block beside a shallow crater.

motifs.name: Trestle release
motifs.trigger: Remove one support of a loaded timber platform.
sequence: The platform tips or collapses under its stone load.
The falling load strikes lower debris and may open a different shot angle.

motifs.name: Gravel express
motifs.trigger: Break a small gate across a steep gravel-filled channel.
sequence: GRAVEL flows down the stone chute.
The pile accumulates below a nearby ledge without crossing the protected foundation.

themes.name: Storm Collector
themes.description: An exposed ridge carries stacked water catchments, broken gutters and weathered machinery. Broad dry ledges remain between cascading side pools and sparse storm-scarred growth.

motifs.name: Three catchments
motifs.trigger: Break the upper basin's timber gate.
sequence: WATER pours into a middle basin with a lower overflow lip.
The overflow feeds a third side pool, exposing a clear sequential path.

motifs.name: Fallen gutter
motifs.trigger: Destroy one end support of a long metal channel body.
sequence: The channel rotates or drops through native contact.
It lands across a lower plank and changes the route of an existing water spill.

motifs.name: Endless-looking rain
motifs.trigger: Open a blocked gutter beneath the elevated feed.
sequence: A configured bounded WATER spawner feeds the upper catchment.
A downstream PARTICLE_DRAIN and output limits keep the effect finite in resource cost.

themes.name: World Beneath the Landfill
themes.description: A crust of soil and junk covers old machinery, timber braces and small fuel chambers. Shooting the right support exposes a cavity instead of merely digging another straight shaft.

motifs.name: The roof under the rubbish
motifs.trigger: Break a timber brace beneath a shallow debris cap.
sequence: A concrete roof segment falls into an already authored cavity.
Loose material above it settles into the opening and changes support near the firing lane.

motifs.name: Old fuel line
motifs.trigger: Break a glass separator in a small buried oil chamber.
sequence: CRUDE_OIL runs along a side tunnel toward an independently contained ignition site.
Native fire can consume timber near the tunnel, allowing a supported iron weight to fall.

motifs.name: Junk slide
motifs.trigger: Remove the chock under a rounded metal body on a wooden ramp.
sequence: The body rolls into two separate resting scrap shapes.
The final object drops into a shallow trench, redistributing the visible obstruction.

placement.centralPolicy: Place one readable assembly beside the central tank lane, outside the exact deployment footprint; keep every tank within the active survivor frame.
placement.otherSitesPolicy: Four seeded sites across the arena; off-camera construction alone does not establish remote thermal/device behavior.

motifTemplates.counterweight: Two destructible supports, a sloping deck and a separate rolling/falling solid load; additional story dressing never replaces native contact.
motifTemplates.spillway: A small supported reservoir with a breakable lip or gate and a lower catchment; include a configured drain only after native device acceptance.
motifTemplates.fuel-cell: A small contained fuel pocket with a destructible separator between fuel and ignition, plus a lower containment basin.
motifTemplates.scope: kind and parameters select the bounded initial assembly; each longer narrative sequence still needs its own physical construction and acceptance.
